SELECT 'bookings' AS kind,json_object('id',booking_id,'request',request_id,'flight',flight_id,'passenger',passenger_id,'amount',amount_cents,'status',status,'client',client_reference) AS data FROM bookings UNION ALL SELECT 'charges',json_object('id',charge_id,'booking',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step) FROM charges UNION ALL SELECT 'events',json_object('id',event_id,'booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('request',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'fares',json_object('id',hold_id,'flight',flight_id,'amount',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'flights',json_object('flight',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'amount',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache

SELECT 'config' kind,service id,value data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'log',CAST(id AS TEXT),json_object('service',service,'path',path,'status',status,'message',message) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs WHERE service='booking' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 25) UNION ALL SELECT 'pending',booking_id,json_object('request',request_id,'amount',amount_cents,'flight',flight_id,'client',client_reference) FROM bookings WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',request_id,json_object('step',step) FROM customer_events

SELECT 'flights' kind,flight_id id,json_object('amount',price_cents,'version',version,'capacity',capacity) data FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'recent_bookings',booking_id,json_object('flight',flight_id,'amount',amount_cents,'status',status,'confirmed',confirmed_at) FROM bookings WHERE confirmed_at>=3 UNION ALL SELECT 'pricing_log',CAST(id AS TEXT),json_object('path',path,'status',status,'message',message) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs WHERE service='pricing' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5)

SELECT b.booking_id,b.status,b.amount_cents,b.client_reference,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) matching_holds,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured') captured_charges,(SELECT SUM(c.amount_cents) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured') captured_cents,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checkins i WHERE i.booking_id=b.booking_id AND i.flight_id=b.flight_id AND i.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) matching_checkins,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered') delivered_events,(SELECT SUM(r.amount_cents) FROM refunds r WHERE r.booking_id=b.booking_id) refunded_cents,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id AND e.kind='cancel') cancel_events FROM bookings b WHERE b.status<>'confirmed' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM checkins i WHERE i.booking_id=b.booking_id) OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured')<>1 OR b.booking_id IN ('bkg_ccf97175b3055db38c934385c79343d7','bkg_f1d0dc1bb3475e1dbff36edb529a9f95','bkg_29c2d59ddc2a5d69b4ce7448f2058bec','bkg_4dedffeb1f6a554e850f74b853854737')
